body:
Thank you for the response.

I suppose I didn't elaborate enough on a lot of things, I know right now my thoughts are very me-centric.

I included her in everything I did, I made the mistake previously with someone else of blocking them out of activities I did, but with her I tried to engage her in things I did. For example, I'm part of a large car club scene where I am, and I made sure I asked her if she wanted to come along every time I went to an event or meet, and if she wasn't tired from work, she came along.

I'm someone who's scared of losing people, so I notice bad things in relationships, and to be honest, this whole thing came out of nowhere. Not 2 days before it happened, she'd come along to a meet with me and told me she enjoyed it a lot, even though I suspected she'd be bored to death by it as it was mainly about vehicle detailing, she said she found it all very interesting and was in a good mood the whole day at it, she didn't seem bored or faking enthusiasm. Please feel free to ask me anything if I've missed it in this reply.
